sections.heading: Growing behavior
sections.text:
Cut forests do not regrow, and the small trees (large saplings labelled Beech, Fir, or Pine) do not grow into full sized trees. Some have reported trees spontaneously appearing in rare occasions, but this will not replace a cut forest (and is quite rare).
It is however possible to plant tree saplings using the Cultivator and seeds from some tree species. Planted saplings grow into large trees over time. A sapling will grow into a tree after a random passage of time, between 3000s and 8000s (between 50m and 133m20s, or about 1.67-4.44 in-game days). Keep in mind that some trees have shorter maximum growth time and some have longer minimum growth time. For tree farms, it is recommended that you plant each sapling 4 meters apart in order to avoid overcrowding, which will eliminate some saplings as surrounding trees mature. Spacing can be measured by placing poles along one edge of the farm for reference, with the spacing measured by temporarily placing two 2 meter beams.
Ancient trees, Yggdrasil shoots and Scorched Trees do not produce seeds and cannot be planted with the cultivator.

Ancient Tree. Can be found in the Swamp.

Yggdrasil shoot. Can be found in the Mistlands.
